transcript.text: Good morning. Let's get started with the 0700 maintenance sync. Motor pool queue has FL-2 first, V-21 second, GEN-5 third, since FL-2's parts are already staged. Anything that would change that order or affect the 0800-to-1600 maintenance window?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.speaker: A3
